claims.statement: Tom Allen was to fight Gallagher in a prize fight on Tuesday, November 1, 1870.
claims.excerpt: The approaching prize fight between Tom Allen and Gallegher, which isto take place on Tuesd.r,

claims.statement: Mace and B. Aaron were to be the seconds of Tom Allen for the fight with Gallagher.
claims.excerpt: Mace and B. Aaron will be the seconds of Allen

fights.excerpt: The approaching prize fight between Tom Allen and Gallegher, which isto take place on Tuesd.r,
fights.notes: Advance notice; the fight place is not given and the outcome is not in this text. Gallegher is printed in the text; spelled Gallagher in the statement.

notes: Hints named Barney Aaron and the Belle Ida; the text gives B. Aaron and only the boat's departure point.
